capabilities: Reverse the order of image and video embeds in the active note
Restore the original embed order by running the command again
Trigger reversal via ribbon button, three-dot menu, command palette, or hotkey
Skip frontmatter, code blocks, HTML, unresolved links, audio, and PDFs
extras: Supports Chinese and English automatically based on Obsidian's interface language; manual installation instructions are included; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to quickly flip the sequence of embedded media in a note, which is tedious to do by editing each embed manually.
summary: One-click command that reverses the order of all image and video embeds in the active note, with a second click or undo restoring the original order.
